title: Talent selected for Airbnb
intro: Prepared by Irvin Thevaranjan through the independent Ex-GH Talent Network. A focused selection of public profiles with experience relevant to Airbnb opportunities reviewed October 19, 2026. These are potential alignments, with specific points to explore on each card. Reply to Irvin to discuss interest and introductions.

items.note: Led multi-team engineering organizations across subscriptions, payments, and platform systems. Explore five-plus years of management, architecture ownership, and high-availability payment or regulated-domain delivery.

Product leadership in integrations, API launches, and platform features is relevant to developer-facing product ownership. Explore three-plus years building developer platforms, Pacific-hours coverage, and frequent travel expectations.

Systems design, marketplace analytics, and technical platform experience create a relevant starting point. Explore product leadership for developers, API ecosystem ownership, customer-facing product messaging, and frequent travel.

PMP-certified program management and extensive customer-support operations experience align with cross-functional support initiatives. Explore contact-center technology delivery, business cases, and executive stakeholder management.

Enterprise onboarding, compliance operations, and process improvement provide relevant operational context. Explore formal program ownership, contact-center technology, measurable business cases, and the desired individual-contributor scope.

Operations leadership, analytics, and AI-assisted process automation using Python, SQL, and Databricks are relevant. Explore contact-center depth, process-engineering methods, statistical analysis, and travel up to 20%.

Enterprise partner marketing, monetization, and cross-functional growth work provide relevant partner context. Explore direct deal ownership, referral or revenue-share economics, partner-program creation, and ROI modeling.

Ten-plus years of partnership and strategic client relationship experience align with managing live partners. Explore complex deal negotiations, revenue-share or loyalty models, portfolio growth, and product-integration work.
